notes.title: Game launch & V1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Updated to version 1.3[/h1]

[list]

[*][b]Improved controls:[/b]
You can shoot bananas choosing between press the square button, cross button, and circle button at Dual Shock
You can shoot bananas choosing between press the X button, B button, and A button at Xbox and Xinput gamepads

[*][b]Fixed issue that will throw bananas while resuming the game[/b]

[/list]
